g.text: The dash boards take +12 V / GND on screw terminals and receive serial on COM (buses on sheets 2 and 3).

g.desc: The dash boards take +12 V / GND on screw terminals and receive serial on COM (buses on sheets 2 and 3).

g.text: DASH_0V is the return for every dash board and both pods, back to the fuse block V− (0V).

g.desc: DASH_0V is the return for every dash board and both pods, back to the fuse block V− (0V).

g.text: Dummy chains: E → G on the rpints dummy bus, B → F on the brewpi speedo bus. The boards' own TX terminals are unconnected.

g.desc: Dummy chains: E → G on the rpints dummy bus, B → F on the brewpi speedo bus. The boards' own TX terminals are unconnected.

g.text: Both Pis are on the switched rail: the POWER latch, or pulling fuse V1, cuts them.

g.desc: Both Pis are on the switched rail: the POWER latch, or pulling fuse V1, cuts them.

g.text: Four wires per switch: C, NO, lamp 5, lamp 2 — two uxcell 8-core cables. Pursuit and Power are mounted upside down relative to Auto and Norm.

g.desc: Four wires per switch: C, NO, lamp 5, lamp 2 — two uxcell 8-core cables. Pursuit and Power are mounted upside down relative to Auto and Norm.

g.text: 1: 0 V, jumpered to 2 — return for the four dash cables

g.desc: 1: 0 V, jumpered to 2 — return for the four dash cables

g.text: 3: 0 V in (P1) · PANP lamp 0 V → middle strip 8

g.desc: 3: 0 V in (P1) · PANP lamp 0 V → middle strip 8

g.text: Sheet 4 — strip 1 to the Pi converters, the DASH POWER block to the six dash boards, and the four PANP switches as they land on the two 8-way strips.

g.desc: Sheet 4 — strip 1 to the Pi converters, the DASH POWER block to the six dash boards, and the four PANP switches as they land on the two 8-way strips.

g.text: The switches' commoned C reaches rpints GND via middle strip 2; the lamp 0 V lines reach strip 1 terminal 3 (0V) via middle strip 8.

g.desc: The switches' commoned C reaches rpints GND via middle strip 2; the lamp 0 V lines reach strip 1 terminal 3 (0V) via middle strip 8.
